**What went into memory:** all 190 messages of week 2001-W16 (6874–7063). Every one of the 151 messages with notes is cited in a domain or people file, so `dataset/drops/sleep-074.tsv` is empty. Earlier runs also committed empty drops files.

- The five oldest "still true" lines are still valid.
- The one open question (alias approval) isn't due until 2001-05-1
